name: merge-button
title: Merge button
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Stays disabled until checks pass, asks before merging, and ends on Merged into main.

meta.descriptionEs: Se habilita con todas las comprobaciones en verde, pide confirmación y termina en Fusionado en main.

examples.title: Botón de fusión
examples.description: Listo, en espera, fusionando, rechazado y fusionado.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: 390 px y un motivo de 60 caracteres.

api.name: phase
api.description: disabled, ready, confirming, merging, merged, or rejected.

api.name: onMerge
api.description: Runs only after the reader confirms.

api.name: reason
api.description: Shown when the branch protection rejects the merge.

api.name: variant / labels
api.description: English by default. mergeButtonLabelsEs is es-MX.

docs: Clean-room. Idea only, no license (Phil Pitus, Generative UI #6). onMerge runs only from the confirm button. A rejected phase shows the branch protection reason as text. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button. No theme. English labels are the default; mergeButtonLabelsEs is es-MX.
